/bin/bash -lc "python - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
p=Path('/localhome/milikic/proof-reduction-competition/.proof-eval-projects/arklib-v4.31.0/ArkLib/ProofSystem/Binius/BinaryBasefold/Prelude.lean')
s=p.read_text()
a=s.index('theorem fold_advances_evaluation_poly\\n')
b=s.index(' := by\\n  simp only\\n  intro y',a)+len(' := by\\n')
body='''  intro P_i f_i f_i_plus_1 new_coeffs P_i_plus_1 y
  let fiberMap := qMap_total_fiber 𝔽q β (i := ⟨i, by omega⟩) (steps := 1)
    (h_i_add_steps := h_i_succ_lt) (y := y)
  have hq (k : Fin 2) : (AdditiveNTT.qMap 𝔽q β ⟨i, by omega⟩).eval
      (fiberMap k).val = y.val := by
    have h := generates_quotient_point_if_is_fiber_of_y 𝔽q β i 1 (by omega)
      (fiberMap k) y ⟨k, rfl⟩
    rw [iteratedQuotientMap_k_eq_1_is_qMap] at h
    exact (congrArg Subtype.val h).symm
  have hdiff : (fiberMap 1).val - (fiberMap 0).val = 1 := by
    dsimp only [fiberMap]
    rw [qMap_total_fiber_one_level_eq 𝔽q β i (by omega) y 1,
      qMap_total_fiber_one_level_eq 𝔽q β i (by omega) y 0]
    simp [Fin2ToF2, Submodule.coe_add, get_sDomain_first_basis_eq_1]
  let P₀ := evenRefinement 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate i coeffs
  let P₁ := oddRefinement 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate i coeffs
  have heval (k : Fin 2) : P_i.eval (fiberMap k).val =
      P₀.eval y.val + (fiberMap k).val * P₁.eval y.val := by
    have hsplit := evaluation_poly_split_identity 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate i coeffs
    simp only [P_i, hsplit, Polynomial.eval_add, eval_comp, hq,
      Polynomial.eval_mul, Polynomial.eval_X, P₀, P₁]
  change P_i.eval (fiberMap 0).val * ((1 - r_chal) * (fiberMap 1).val - r_chal) +
    P_i.eval (fiberMap 1).val * (r_chal - (1 - r_chal) * (fiberMap 0).val) = _
  rw [heval 0, heval 1]
  calc
    _ = (P₀.eval y.val * (1 - r_chal) + P₁.eval y.val * r_chal) *
        ((fiberMap 1).val - (fiberMap 0).val) := by ring
    _ = P₀.eval y.val * (1 - r_chal) + P₁.eval y.val * r_chal := by rw [hdiff, mul_one]
    _ = P_i_plus_1.eval y.val := by
      simp only [P_i_plus_1, P₀, P₁, new_coeffs, evenRefinement, oddRefinement,
        intermediateEvaluationPoly, Polynomial.eval_finset_sum, Polynomial.eval_mul,
        Polynomial.eval_C]
      rw [Finset.sum_mul, Finset.sum_mul, ←Finset.sum_add_distrib]
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro j hj
      ring
'''
Path('candidate.lean').write_text(s[a:b]+body)
PY
python check_candidate.py candidate.lean"
